typography.heading: Unbounded or Outfit (Neon/Gaming aesthetic)
rules: Uppercase with tracking-[0.2em] for overlines and rarity labels.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use 1px borders (border-white/10) to separate grid items. Glassmorphism with saturation boost (backdrop-saturate-150 backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60) for sticky header. NO fully transparent headers.
visual_enhancers.effects: Neon glows via drop-shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(139,92,246,0.5)] on active elements. Subtle grain texture overlay to reduce digital flatness.

grids_and_layouts.general: Bento Grid Protocol. Asymmetrical layouts. Mobile-first grid-cols-1, scaling to md:grid-cols-8 or lg:grid-cols-12 for hero.
grids_and_layouts.catalog: Dense grid for catalog, strict hierarchy. Apply generous spacing inside cards.
grids_and_layouts.checkout_flow: Step-by-step layout (6 pasos) with generous spacing (p-8 to p-12).

components.cards: Flat background with 1px border. Hover: translate-y-1, neon drop shadow.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly angled (skew-x) for a gaming feel. Vibrant gradients for 'Comprar' or 'Siguiente'.
components.checkout_steps: Progress bar or stepped vertical/horizontal nodes.
components.html2canvas_target: A specific DOM element with solid background (NOT glass) so html2canvas renders correctly.

motion.transitions: Use specific properties (transition: transform 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease). NO transition-all.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text over neon elements meets 4.5:1. Use dark text on neon backgrounds.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute.

images.description: Gamer setup background (Use with heavy dark overlay bg-black/70)

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the 6-step purchase flow state management.
The 6 steps are: 1. Catálogo -> 2. Selección de cantidades -> 3. Resumen -> 4. Datos de usuario -> 5. Confirmación -> 6. Generación de imagen.
Implement the spirit selection with country/currency state overriding prices dynamically.
For HTML2Canvas, ensure the receipt/image container has NO cross-origin un-proxied images or handle them gracefully, and use solid backgrounds.
Ensure logic is split into separate JS files: config.js, prices.js, spirits.js, payments.js, reviews.js to act as mock databases.
Use Phosphor icons or Lucide for UI elements.
All text MUST be in Spanish as per user choice.
Implement quantity discounts logic explicitly in the cart step.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts. Prioritize visual tension and alignment.
Do not use transparent header backgrounds, always use glassmorphism.
Ensure dark mode is NOT just black and white, but layered charcoals with neon accents.
All interactive elements must include `data-testid` attribute.
